prompts.luna_izq: Moonlit night scene. Everything is bathed in cold blue moonlight coming from the right: silver-blue rim light on the ridges, deep navy-blue shadows in every gully, strong blue color grading, local colors desaturated by the moonlight, very dark sky with a few stars. The landscape covers the whole mountain from base to summit. Treat the mountain as one continuous surface texture: vegetation only as low ground cover or as a continuous canopy seen from above, no isolated tall trees, no tall cacti, no poles, no vertical objects, no buildings. The beauty comes from color, rock texture, strata and the raking light that sculpts every ridge and gully. Dense Paranaense subtropical rainforest of Misiones covering the mountain as a continuous canopy seen from above: lush green treetops with pink blossoms of lapacho, patches of red earth, mist drifting over the canopy. Natural landscape photography, highly detailed, realistic textures, no people, no text, no buildings unless described.
